# cloudraya_vm_storage_package (Data Source)

Looks up a CloudRaya block-storage (data disk) package by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudraya_vm_storage_package" "disk" {
  name = "Disk-50"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Storage package name, for example `Disk-50`.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project to query under. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `region_id` (String) Region the package must be active in. Optional: storage packages are commonly offered everywhere, so omit this to match by name alone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Package identifier (ULID), usable as a volume `product_id`.
- `status_text` (String) Package status.
